rationale: Issue numbers are immutable and globally unique; types are mutable. 7 retypes have already split history across two keys. Add issue_num INTEGER as join key alongside issue_id TEXT for display; numeric-only loses reconstructability (issue_type NULL in ~2-3% of rows) and degrades search_index.ref FTS quality.
rule: Captured: Key history tables on the stable numeric issue id, not the mutable TYPE-NNN string
